verses.text_uthmani: قٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ

trs.20: Qāf.<sup foot_note=197405>1</sup> By the honored Qur’ān...<sup foot_note=197404>2</sup>
trs.85: Qaf By the glorious Quran!
trs.22: Qaf: By the Glorious Qur'an (Thou art Allah's Messenger).
trs.203: Qâf. [These letters (Qâf, etc.) are one of the miracles of the Qur’ân, and none but Allâh (Alone) knows their meanings]. By the Glorious Qur’ân.

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ

trs.20: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.
trs.85: But the disbelievers are amazed that a warner has come from among them and they say, ‘How strange!
trs.22: But they wonder that there has come to them a Warner from among themselves. So the Unbelievers say: "This is a wonderful thing!
trs.203: Nay, they wonder that there has come to them a warner (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from among themselves. So the disbelievers say: "This is a strange thing!

verses.text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌ

trs.20: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant [i.e., unlikely] return."
trs.85: To come back [to life] after we have died and become dust? That is too farfetched.’
trs.22: "What! When we die and become dust, (shall we live again?) That is a (sort of) return far (from our understanding)."
trs.203: "When we are dead and have become dust (shall we be resurrected?) That is a far return."

verses.text_uthmani: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَـٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ

trs.20: We know what the earth diminishes [i.e., consumes] of them, and with Us is a retaining record.
trs.85: We know very well what the earth takes away from them: We keep a comprehensive record.
trs.22: We already know how much of them the earth takes away: With Us is a record guarding (the full account).
trs.203: We know that which the earth takes of them (their dead bodies), and with Us is a Book preserved (i.e. the Book of Decrees).

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍ مَّرِيجٍ

trs.20: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.
trs.85: But the disbelievers deny the truth when it comes to them; they are in a state of confusion.
trs.22: But they deny the Truth when it comes to them: so they are in a confused state.
trs.203: Nay, but they have denied the truth (this Qur’ân) when it has come to them, so they are in a confused state (cannot differentiate between right and wrong).

verses.text_uthmani: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍ

trs.20: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?
trs.85: Do they not see the sky above them––how We have built and adorned it, with no rifts in it;
trs.22: Do they not look at the sky above them?- How We have made it and adorned it, and there are no flaws in it?
trs.203: Have they not looked at the heaven above them, how We have made it and adorned it, and there are no rifts in it?

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍ

trs.20: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,
trs.85: how We spread out the earth and put solid mountains on it, and caused every kind of joyous plant to grow in it,
trs.22: And the earth- We have spread it out, and set thereon mountains standing firm, and produced therein every kind of beautiful growth (in pairs)-
trs.203: And the earth! We have spread it out, and set thereon mountains standing firm, and have produced therein every kind of lovely growth (plants).

verses.text_uthmani: تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ

trs.20: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allāh].
trs.85: as a lesson and reminder for every servant who turns to God;
trs.22: To be observed and commemorated by every devotee turning (to Allah).
trs.203: An insight and a Reminder for every slave who turns to Allâh in repentance (i.e. the one who believes in the Oneness of Allâh and performs deeds of His obedience, and always begs His pardon).

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً مُّبَـٰرَكًا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ

trs.20: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
trs.85: and how We send blessed water down from the sky and grow with it gardens, the harvest grain,
trs.22: And We send down from the sky rain charted with blessing, and We produce therewith gardens and Grain for harvests;
trs.203: And We send down blessed water (rain) from the sky, then We produce therewith gardens and grain (every kind of harvests) that are reaped.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَـٰتٍ لَّهَا طَلْعٌ نَّضِيدٌ

trs.20: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -
trs.85: and tall palm trees laden with clusters of dates,
trs.22: And tall (and stately) palm-trees, with shoots of fruit-stalks, piled one over another;-
trs.203: And tall date-palms, with ranged clusters.

verses.text_uthmani: رِّزْقًا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ

trs.20: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the emergence [i.e., resurrection].
trs.85: as a provision for everyone; how with water We give [new] life to a land that is dead? This is how the dead will emerge [from their graves].
trs.22: As sustenance for (Allah's) Servants;- and We give (new) life therewith to land that is dead: Thus will be the Resurrection.
trs.203: A provision for (Allâh’s) slaves. And We give life therewith to a dead land. Thus will be the resurrection (of the dead).

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ

trs.20: The people of Noah denied before them,<sup foot_note=197407>1</sup> and the companions of the well<sup foot_note=197406>2</sup> and Thamūd
trs.85: The people of Noah disbelieved long before these disbelievers, as did the people of Rass, Thamud,
trs.22: Before them was denied (the Hereafter) by the People of Noah, the Companions of the Rass, the Thamud,
trs.203: Denied before them (i.e. these pagans of Makkah) the people of Nûh (Noah), and the dwellers of Rass, and Thamûd;

verses.text_uthmani: وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍ

trs.20: And ʿAad and Pharaoh and the brothers [i.e., people] of Lot
trs.85: Ad, Pharaoh, Lot,
trs.22: The 'Ad, Pharaoh, the brethren of Lut,
trs.203: And ‘Âd, and Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), and the brethren of Lût (Lot);

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ ۚ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ

trs.20: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.
trs.85: the Forest-Dwellers, Tubba: all of these people disbelieved their messengers, and so My warning was realized.
trs.22: The Companions of the Wood, and the People of Tubba'; each one (of them) rejected the messengers, and My warning was duly fulfilled (in them).
trs.203: And the Dwellers of the Wood, and the people of Tubba‘. Everyone of them denied (their) Messengers, so My Threat took effect.

verses.text_uthmani: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ

trs.20: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
trs.85: So were We incapable of the first creation? No indeed! Yet they doubt a second creation.
trs.22: Were We then weary with the first Creation, that they should be in confused doubt about a new Creation?
trs.203: Were We then tired with the first creation? Nay, they are in confused doubt about a new creation (i.e. Resurrection).

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ

trs.20: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer<sup foot_note=197408>1</sup> to him than [his] jugular vein.
trs.85: We created man––We know what his soul whispers to him: We are closer to him than his jugular vein––
trs.22: It was We Who created man, and We know what dark suggestions his soul makes to him: for We are nearer to him than (his) jugular vein.
trs.203: And indeed We have created man, and We know what his ownself whispers to him. And We are nearer to him than his jugular vein (by Our Knowledge).

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ

trs.20: When the two receivers [i.e., recording angels] receive,<sup foot_note=197409>1</sup> seated on the right and on the left.
trs.85: with two receptors set to record, one on his right side and one on his left:
trs.22: Behold, two (guardian angels) appointed to learn (his doings) learn (and noted them), one sitting on the right and one on the left.
trs.203: (Remember) that the two receivers (recording angels) receive (each human being),<sup foot_note=154924>1</sup> one sitting on the right and one on the left (to note his or her actions).<sup foot_note=154925>2</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ

trs.20: He [i.e., man] utters no word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].
trs.85: he does not utter a single word without an ever-present watcher.
trs.22: Not a word does he utter but there is a sentinel by him, ready (to note it).
trs.203: Not a word does he (or she) utter but there is a watcher by him ready (to record it).<sup foot_note=154926>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ

trs.20: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
trs.85: The trance of death will bring the Truth with it: ‘This is what you tried to escape.’
trs.22: And the stupor of death will bring Truth (before his eyes): "This was the thing which thou wast trying to escape!"
trs.203: And the stupor of death will come in truth: "This is what you have been avoiding!"

verses.text_uthmani: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ

trs.20: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.
trs.85: The Trumpet will be sounded: ‘This is the Day [you were] warned of.’
trs.22: And the Trumpet shall be blown: that will be the Day whereof Warning (had been given).
trs.203: And the Trumpet will be blown - that will be the Day whereof warning (had been given) (i.e. the Day of Resurrection).

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ

trs.20: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.<sup foot_note=197410>1</sup>
trs.85: Each person will arrive attended by an [angel] to drive him on and another to bear witness:
trs.22: And there will come forth every soul: with each will be an (angel) to drive, and an (angel) to bear witness.
trs.203: And every person will come forth along with an (angel) to drive (him) and an (angel) to bear witness.

verses.text_uthmani: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ

trs.20: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover,<sup foot_note=197411>1</sup> so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
trs.85: ‘You paid no attention to this [Day]; but today We have removed your veil and your sight is sharp.’
trs.22: (It will be said:) "Thou wast heedless of this; now have We removed thy veil, and sharp is thy sight this Day!"
trs.203: (It will be said to the sinners): "Indeed you were heedless of this. Now We have removed from you your covering, and sharp is your sight this Day!"

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَـٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ

trs.20: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."
trs.85: The person’s attendant will say, ‘Here is what I have prepared’-
trs.22: And his Companion will say: "Here is (his Record) ready with me!"
trs.203: And his companion (angel) will say: "Here is (this Record) ready with me!"

verses.text_uthmani: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ

trs.20: [Allāh will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,
trs.85: ‘Hurl every obstinate disbeliever into Hell,
trs.22: (The sentence will be:) "Throw, throw into Hell every contumacious Rejecter (of Allah)!-
trs.203: (Allah will say to the angels): "Both of you throw into Hell every stubborn disbeliever (in the Oneness of Allâh, in His Messengers).

verses.text_uthmani: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِيبٍ

trs.20: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,
trs.85: everyone who hindered good, was aggressive, caused others to doubt,
trs.22: "Who forbade what was good, transgressed all bounds, cast doubts and suspicions;
trs.203: "Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter,

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ

trs.20: Who made [as equal] with Allāh another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."
trs.85: and set up other gods alongside God. Hurl him into severe punishment!’-
trs.22: "Who set up another god beside Allah: Throw him into a severe penalty."
trs.203: "Who set up another ilâh (god) with Allâh. Then both of you cast him in the severe torment."

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَـٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ

trs.20: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."
trs.85: and his [evil] companion will say, ‘Lord, I did not make him transgress; he had already gone far astray himself.’
trs.22: His Companion will say: "Our Lord! I did not make him transgress, but he was (himself) far astray."
trs.203: His companion (Satan - devil)] will say: "Our Lord! I did not push him to transgression, (in disbelief, oppression, and evil deeds) but he was himself in error far astray."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ

trs.20: [Allāh] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the threat [i.e., warning].
trs.85: God will say, ‘Do not argue in My presence. I sent you a warning
trs.22: He will say: "Dispute not with each other in My Presence: I had already in advance sent you Warning.
trs.203: Allâh will say: "Dispute not in front of Me, I had already in advance sent you the threat.

verses.text_uthmani: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّـٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ

trs.20: The word [i.e., decree] will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."
trs.85: and My word cannot be changed: I am not unjust to any creature.’
trs.22: "The Word changes not before Me, and I do not the least injustice to My Servants."
trs.203: The Sentence that comes from Me cannot be changed, and I am not unjust to the slaves."

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍ

trs.20: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"
trs.85: We shall say to Hell on that day, ‘Are you full?’ and it will reply, ‘Are there no more?’
trs.22: One Day We will ask Hell, "Art thou filled to the full?" It will say, "Are there any more (to come)?"
trs.203: On the Day when We will say to Hell: "Are you filled?" It will say: "Are there any more (to come)?"<sup foot_note=154927>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ

trs.20: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,
trs.85: But Paradise will be brought close to the righteous and will no longer be distant:
trs.22: And the Garden will be brought nigh to the Righteous,- no more a thing distant.
trs.203: And Paradise will be brought near to the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2), not far off.

verses.text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ

trs.20: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allāh] and keeper [of His covenant].
trs.85: ‘This is what you were promised––this is for everyone who turned often to God and kept Him in mind,
trs.22: (A voice will say:) "This is what was promised for you,- for every one who turned (to Allah) in sincere repentance, who kept (His Law),
trs.203: (It will be said): "This is what you were promised - (it is) for those oft-returning (to Allâh) in sincere repentance, and those who preserve their covenant with Allâh (by obeying Him in all what He has ordered, and worshipping none but Allâh Alone, i.e. follow Allâh’s religion - Islâmic Monotheism).

verses.text_uthmani: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُّنِيبٍ

trs.20: Who feared the Most Merciful in the unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].
trs.85: who held the Most Gracious in awe, though He is unseen, who comes before Him with a heart turned to Him in devotion-
trs.22: "Who feared (Allah) Most Gracious Unseen, and brought a heart turned in devotion (to Him):
trs.203: "Who feared the Most Gracious (Allâh) in the Ghaib (Unseen) and brought a heart turned in repentance (to Him and absolutely free from each and every kind of polytheism).

verses.text_uthmani: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ

trs.20: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."
trs.85: so enter it in peace. This is the Day of everlasting Life.’
trs.22: "Enter ye therein in Peace and Security; this is a Day of Eternal Life!"
trs.203: "Enter you therein in peace and security - this is a Day of eternal life!"

verses.text_uthmani: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ

trs.20: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.
trs.85: They will have all that they wish for there, and We have more for them.
trs.22: There will be for them therein all that they wish,- and more besides in Our Presence.
trs.203: There they will have all that they desire - and We have more (for them, i.e. a glance at the All-Mighty, All-Majestic جل جلاله).

verses.text_uthmani: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ

trs.20: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?
trs.85: We have destroyed even mightier generations before these disbelievers, who travelled through [many] lands- was there any escape?
trs.22: But how many generations before them did We destroy (for their sins),- stronger in power than they? Then did they wander through the land: was there any place of escape (for them)?
trs.203: And how many a generation We have destroyed before them who were stronger in power than they. And (when Our Torment came), they ran for a refuge in the land! Could they find any place of refuge (for them to save themselves from destruction)?

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ

trs.20: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].
trs.85: There truly is a reminder in this for whoever has a heart, whoever listens attentively.
trs.22: Verily in this is a Message for any that has a heart and understanding or who gives ear and earnestly witnesses (the truth).
trs.203: Verily, therein is indeed a reminder for him who has a heart or gives ear while he is heedful.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ

trs.20: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.
trs.85: We created the heavens, the earth, and everything between, in six Days without tiring.
trs.22: We created the heavens and the earth and all between them in Six Days, nor did any sense of weariness touch Us.
trs.203: And indeed We created the heavens and the earth and all between them in six Days and nothing of fatigue touched Us.

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ

trs.20: So be patient, [O Muḥammad], over what they say and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,
trs.85: So [Prophet], bear everything they say with patience; celebrate the praise of your Lord before the rising and setting of the sun;
trs.22: Bear, then, with patience, all that they say, and celebrate the praises of thy Lord, before the rising of the sun and before (its) setting.
trs.203: So bear with patience (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) all that they say, and glorify the Praises of your Lord, before the rising of the sun and before (its) setting (i.e. the Fajr, Zuhr, and ‘Asr prayers)<sup foot_note=154928>1</sup>.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَـٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ

trs.20: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration [i.e., prayer].
trs.85: proclaim His praise in the night and at the end of every prayer;
trs.22: And during part of the night, (also,) celebrate His praises, and (so likewise) after the postures of adoration.
trs.203: And during a part of the night (also) glorify His praises (i.e. Maghrib and ‘Isha prayers) and (so likewise) after the prayers [As-Sunnah, Nawâfil - optional and additional prayers. And also glorify, praise and magnify Allâh - Subhân Allâh, Alhamdu lillâh, Allâhu-Akbar].

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ

trs.20: And listen on the Day when the Caller<sup foot_note=197412>1</sup> will call out from a place that is near -
trs.85: listen out for the Day when the caller will call from a nearby place.
trs.22: And listen for the Day when the Caller will call out from a place quiet near,-
trs.203: And listen on the Day when the caller will call from a near place.

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ

trs.20: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
trs.85: They will come out [from their graves] on that Day, the Day when they hear the mighty blast in reality.
trs.22: The Day when they will hear a (mighty) Blast in (very) truth: that will be the Day of Resurrection.
trs.203: The Day when they will hear As-Saihah (shout) in truth: that will be the Day of coming out (from the graves, i.e. the Day of Resurrection).

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ

trs.20: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
trs.85: It is We who give life and death; the final return will be to Us
trs.22: Verily it is We Who give Life and Death; and to Us is the Final Goal-
trs.203: Verily, We it is Who give life and cause death; and to Us is the final return.

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ

trs.20: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.
trs.85: on the Day when the earth will be torn apart, letting them rush out- that gathering will be easy for Us.
trs.22: The Day when the Earth will be rent asunder, from (men) hurrying out: that will be a gathering together,- quite easy for Us.
trs.203: On the Day when the earth shall be cleft, from off them, (they will come out) hastening forth. That will be a gathering, quite easy for Us.

verses.text_uthmani: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ

trs.20: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant.<sup foot_note=197413>1</sup> But remind by the Qur’ān whoever fears My threat.
trs.85: We know best what the disbelievers say. You [Prophet] are not there to force them, so remind, with this Quran, those who fear My warning.
trs.22: We know best what they say; and thou art not one to overawe them by force. So admonish with the Qur'an such as fear My Warning!
trs.203: We know best what they say. And you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are not the one to force them (to Belief). But warn by the Qur’an; him who fears My Threat.
